props.name: label
props.description: Visible group label, rendered as a legend.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Replaces the hint and marks the group invalid.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stack the options, or lay them out in a row.

props.name: variant
props.description: Draw each option as a selectable card rather than a bare row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
